title: Decision: the did_webvh record's component ID defaults to private-use 0xF013 and stays a setting
description:
With the record carried only as an app_data_dictionary component (mimid-1wgh.4.81.34, Mark 2026-11-18), it needs an MLS Component Types value (mls-extensions-11 §7.5). draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00 §IANA Considerations names only TBD2 (suggested 0x0013) in the MLS Extension Types registry, and no component value.

Readings: (a) reuse 0x0013 as the component ID: it is in the Specification Required range (0x0000-0x7FFF), unassigned now, so squatting it could collide with a later IANA assignment, and a peer reading the -00 draft would take 0x0013 as an extension type, not a component; (b) a private-use value (0x8000-0xFFFF), which cannot collide with an assignment; (c) no default, require configuration.

Chosen: (b), 0xF013, the spike's test value (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.33), as CodePoints::DEFAULT, still configurable: CodePoints::new(credential_type, heads_component), [did_webvh] heads_component in the server and agent TOML (replacing heads_extension_type). INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. new() now also refuses 0x0003-0x0005 (content_media_types, last_resort_key_package, app_ack, assigned by §7.5), which the spike accepted. The credential type keeps the draft's suggested 0x0008. If -01 suggests a component value, the default follows it.
